pipelines.name: E2E Testing

steps.name: e2e/build-image
steps.run:
make docker-build CI=false
if [[ ${{steps.try-checkout.outcome}} == 'failure' ]]; then
  RTCD_IMAGE="rtcd:master"
else
  RTCD_IMAGE="rtcd:dev-$(git log --pretty=format:'%h' -n 1)"
fi
docker tag "${RTCD_IMAGE}" "rtcd:e2e"
docker save --output rtcd.tar "rtcd:e2e"

steps.name: e2e/generate-configuration
steps.run:
go work init . ./public
mkdir -p ${{ github.workspace }}/config
cd scripts/config_generator
go run main.go

steps.name: e2e/build-e2e-image
steps.run:
echo "Building playwright test image ... "
cp ${{ github.workspace }}/plugin.json plugin.json
docker build --quiet -t mm-playwright -f Playwright.Dockerfile .

pipelines.name: E2E Report Generation

steps.name: e2e-report/generate-reporting
steps.run:
DATETIME="$(date '+%Y_%m_%d__%H_%M_%S')"

echo "Installing pinned Playwright (for merge-reports) ... "
# Use the exact Playwright version the e2e suite ran with, so the
# blob reports are merged by a matching release. Merging never launches
# a browser, so skip the browser download to keep this step fast.
( cd "${{ github.workspace }}/e2e" && PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 npm ci )
PLAYWRIGHT="${{ github.workspace }}/e2e/node_modules/.bin/playwright"

echo "Collecting per-shard blob reports ... "
mkdir -p all-blob-reports
n=0
for f in $(find . -path '*blob-report*' -name '*.zip' | sort); do
  cp "$f" "all-blob-reports/report-${n}.zip"
  n=$((n + 1))
done
echo "Found ${n} blob report(s) to merge."

echo "Merging into a single HTML report ... "
"${PLAYWRIGHT}" merge-reports --reporter html ./all-blob-reports

echo "Upload playwright report to S3 ... "
aws s3 sync playwright-report/ s3://${AWS_S3_BUCKET}/calls-pw/${DATETIME} --no-progress --cache-control no-cache

NUM_FAILURES=0
NUM_SUCCESSES=0

for i in $(ls pw-results-*.json)
  do
    # can be `failed`, `flaky`, `timedOut`
    NUM_FAILURES=$((NUM_FAILURES + $(jq '.suites[].suites[].specs[].tests[] | last(.results[]) | select(.status != "passed").status' < ./${i} | wc -l)))
    NUM_SUCCESSES=$((NUM_SUCCESSES + $(jq '.suites[].suites[].specs[].tests[] | last(.results[]) | select(.status == "passed").status' < ./${i} | wc -l)))
done

echo "S3_REPORT=https://${AWS_S3_BUCKET}.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/calls-pw/${DATETIME}/index.html" >> ${GITHUB_OUTPUT}
echo "FAILURES=${NUM_FAILURES}" >> ${GITHUB_OUTPUT}
echo "SUCCESSES=${NUM_SUCCESSES}" >> ${GITHUB_OUTPUT}
echo "TOTAL=$(( ${NUM_SUCCESSES}+${NUM_FAILURES} ))" >> ${GITHUB_OUTPUT}

steps.name: e2e-report/generate-summary
steps.run:
echo "### Playwright Results for [${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-calls/commit/${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }})" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
echo "We had ${{ steps.stats.outputs.FAILURES }} failures" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
echo "We had ${{ steps.stats.outputs.SUCCESSES }} successes" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
echo "You can find the report [here](${{ steps.stats.outputs.S3_REPORT }})" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
